algorithmic_interpretation: No evidence for or against the credit thesis was produced because the live task was malformed at runtime.

completed_before_model_calls.frozen_source_hashes: all matched after syncing the recorded policy-audit fixture

failure.root_cause: RedcoCreditEnv.run applied branch_sampling to the root context agent to set a temperature and seed. branch_sampling is deliberately a one-token action sampler and therefore also forced max_tokens=1. The root protocol requires a multi-token <route>VALUE</route> reply, so every root trace truncated before a valid route could be parsed.
failure.why_tests_missed_it: The environment unit test asserted one-token behavior for branch_sampling and config bounds, but no integration test asserted that context sampling preserves its completion length or produces a parseable route.
failure.stop_reason: Continuing would only generate constant-reward, zero-advantage data. Model calls had already occurred, so the frozen no-retry rule required terminal recovery rather than a same-campaign patch.

artifacts.bundle_policy: All logs, metrics, rollouts, configs, manifests, and resource samples are retained. Two redundant partial broadcast adapters totaling about 505 MiB were excluded.

next_action.cpu_only: Split context sampling from one-token branch sampling, add a regression test for context max_tokens and parseable route behavior, and validate locally/on CPU.
next_action.gpu: Do not rerun this frozen campaign. Any corrected live experiment must be a newly reviewed and preregistered campaign after this terminal failure is accepted.
